scheme_name: Ikhedut Portal Assistance Schemes (Subsidized Farm Machinery)
description: Provides financial assistance for purchasing agricultural equipment such as tractors, power tillers, rotavators, multi-crop threshers, and seed drills to reduce labor dependency.
benefits: 40% to 50% capital subsidy on approved farm machinery (up to ₹60,000–₹1,00,000 depending on the implement and category).
eligibility: Farmers owning agricultural land in Gujarat registered on the Ikhedut portal
Small and marginal farmers, SC/ST, and women farmers receive higher subsidy percentages

description: A state-funded crop protection scheme offering financial compensation without any premium payment by farmers in cases of drought, excessive rainfall, or unseasonal heavy rains.
benefits: Compensation of ₹20,000/hectare for crop loss between 33% and 60% (up to 4 hectares), and ₹25,000/hectare for crop loss above 60% (up to 4 hectares).
eligibility: All land-owning farmers and tenant farmers in Gujarat growing notified crops during Kharif season
application_mode: Online via E-Gram Centers / Ikhedut Portal

description: Provides uninterrupted daytime electricity supply (5:00 AM to 9:00 PM) to farmers for agricultural irrigation.
benefits: Guaranteed daytime power supply for crop irrigation, eliminating the need for hazardous nighttime farming activities.
eligibility: Farmers holding valid agricultural electricity connections across covered villages in Gujarat
documents: Agricultural Electricity Connection Consumer Number / Bill
application_mode: Automatic coverage by DISCOMs (GUVNL / PGVCL / DGVCL / MGVCL / UGVCL)

scheme_name: Gujarat Micro Irrigation Scheme (GGRC - Per Drop More Crop)
description: Promotes micro-irrigation systems (drip and sprinkler) through Gujarat Green Revolution Company (GGRC) to optimize water usage in arid and semi-arid zones.
benefits: 70% to 80% subsidy on total installation costs of drip or sprinkler irrigation systems.
eligibility: Farmers owning cultivable land in Gujarat with access to an assured irrigation source
application_mode: Online via GGRC Portal or through authorized system suppliers

description: Offers assistance for fruit orchards, tissue culture banana, dragon fruit (Kamalam), papaya plantations, shade net houses, and high-tech greenhouses.
benefits: Subsidy ranging from 50% to 75% on planting materials, tissue culture plants, and greenhouse infrastructure setup.
eligibility: Individual farmers, SHGs, and Farmer Producer Organizations (FPOs) cultivating horticultural crops in Gujarat

scheme_name: Mukhya Mantri Natural Farming Scheme (Prakrutik Kheti Scheme)
description: Provides financial incentives to adopt zero-budget natural farming (ZBNF), maintenance of indigenous cows, and purchase of natural input preparation kits.
benefits: Financial assistance of ₹900 per month (₹10,800 per year) per family for maintaining an indigenous (Desi) cow for natural manure preparation, plus ₹750 for natural input kits.
eligibility: Farmers in Gujarat practicing natural farming using indigenous cow-based inputs
documents: Indigenous Cow Tagging / Veterinary Health Certificate
application_mode: Online via Ikhedut Portal / Gram Panchayat Office

scheme_name: Assistance for Fencing Around Agricultural Fields (Solar / Wire Mesh)
description: Offers subsidy for erecting solar powered fencing or barbed wire fencing around farm perimeters to protect crops from wild animals like blue bulls (Nilgai) and wild boars.
benefits: Financial grant up to 50% of the cost (maximum ₹200 per meter or up to ₹1,50,000 per field) for perimeter fencing.
eligibility: Farmers or groups of farmers owning contiguous land plots in Gujarat

scheme_name: Cow-Based Dairy Infrastructure Scheme (Gau Poshak Yojana)
description: Supports livestock rearers in constructing modern cattle sheds, purchasing milking machines, and establishing mini dairy units.
benefits: 50% capital subsidy for cattle shed construction, silage units, and automatic milking machines up to ₹1,50,000.
eligibility: Livestock rearers, milk producers, and dairy SHGs residing in Gujarat
documents: Dairy Cooperative Membership Proof / Cattle Ownership Record
application_mode: Offline / Online via District Animal Husbandry Office / Ikhedut Portal

scheme_name: Assistance for Construction of Farm Ponds (Khet Talavadi)
description: Subsidizes the digging and plastic lining of farm ponds to harvest rainwater for supplementary irrigation in rainfed regions.
benefits: Financial assistance of 50% to 70% of total excavation/lining cost (up to ₹75,000–₹1,00,000 per pond).
eligibility: Land-owning farmers in rain-fed or drought-prone districts of Gujarat
documents: Site Layout Map for proposed pond

scheme_name: Marine & Freshwater Fisheries Infrastructure Subsidy Scheme
description: Provides capital subsidy for purchasing outboard motors, safety equipment, fish drying units, insulated ice boxes, and aquaculture pond construction.
benefits: 40% to 60% financial subsidy on fishing gear, boat engines, insulated transport vehicles, and fish farming inputs.
eligibility: Traditional fishermen, aquaculture farmers, and fisher cooperatives registered in Gujarat
documents: Boat Registration Certificate (for marine fishers) / Land Record (for aquaculture)
application_mode: Offline / Online via Commissionerate of Fisheries / Ikhedut Portal
